title: Authentication & WebSocket hardening (token security, rate limiting, thread safety)
description: Address 13 backend security issues from the PR #1 audit. Covers JWT token storage (localStorage -> httpOnly cookie), token revocation mechanism, separate JWT signing key, refresh token rotation, WebSocket auth via Sec-WebSocket-Protocol, Origin validation, rate limiting on auth/AI endpoints, and thread-safe AI provider fallback with timeouts.
acceptance_criteria: === Token & Authentication Security ===
JWT access token stored in httpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie (removed from localStorage)
Token version field added to User model, included in JWT payload, checked on every decode_token call
Force logout via token version increment on password change
Separate JWT_SIGNING_KEY env var from SECRET_KEY for all JWT operations
Refresh token rotation: old token invalidated on each refresh, new access+refresh pair returned
email field removed from JWT payload (only user_id remains)
registerUser returns generic 'Registration failed' message regardless of cause (prevents email enumeration)
=== WebSocket Security ===
WebSocket auth uses Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header or first-message auth frame (removed ?token= query param)
Origin header validated against FRONTEND_URL in WS consumer connect()
=== Rate Limiting ===
login mutation rate-limited per IP (10 attempts/minute) via Django cache
registerUser mutation rate-limited per IP (1 attempt/minute)
AI generateDraft/translateContent rate-limited per user (20 requests/minute)
=== Thread Safety & Provider Config ===
settings.AI_PROVIDER runtime mutation removed from AiService._get_fallback_provider() — uses provider_name parameter instead
OpenAI and Anthropic API calls have explicit timeout (30s OpenAI, 60s Anthropic)
All existing tests still pass after all changes
